### 📊 ENGAGEMENT INTELLIGENCE — /engagement-check v1.1

**Changes from v1.0:**
Reads from canonical fields (canon_engagement_score,
canon_engagement_status) which are writable.
HubSpot native email fields are read-only and
cannot be seeded for demo purposes.

**Workflow for demo:**
1. Run DEMO SEED v1.1 workflow first
2. Type /engagement-check in Slack
3. Report lands in #marketing

**Post-import wiring check:**
No SplitInBatches here — linear flow only.

**Credentials needed:**
• HubSpot Data Normalization Engine Auth
• Slack Key (httpHeaderAuth, same as Campaign Auditor)
• Slack account (OAuth, same as Campaign Auditor)
